cohort: A birth cohort comprising 15,796 mother-infant pairs in Taiwan.
finding: Cesarean section delivery was associated with an increased risk of Kawasaki disease among both the overall population and a propensity score-matched subpopulation.
mod_finding: Cesarean section delivery was identified as a potential factor increasing the risk of Kawasaki disease in children.
followup_time: Between six and eighteen months after birth
